o.text: From Persian ملا (mollâ), from Arabic مَوْلًى (mawlan, “vicar, guardian”).
Borrowed from Classical Persian راجه (rāja), ultimately from Sanskrit राजन् (rājan).
From duman (“fog”) + -lıq. The sense “nebula” is a semantic loan from Russian тума́нность (tumánnostʹ).
